description: This file contains implementation of distributed tensor operations and collective communication primitives tailored for local simulation within PyTorch's distributed framework. It defines various collective algorithms such as all_gather, reduce_scatter, broadcast, and alltoall, along with auxiliary functions to manage process groups, tensor splitting, and synchronization. The code facilitates collective operations in a local, non-distributed environment by manipulating local tensor data structures and simulating synchronization points.

classes.name: FakeWork
classes.description: A placeholder class simulating asynchronous work objects for collective operations.

classes.name: ProcessGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of processes involved in collective communication, used here primarily as a placeholder.

classes.name: GroupName
classes.description: Type alias for identification of process groups by name.

classes.name: Work
classes.description: Abstracts the work object for asynchronous collective operations.
